## Non-DDD: {data-section="lvl2"}

- Some ATC has by default no DDDs (e.g. topical cremes, vaccines etc)
- Based on size I assume 2-week / 4-week usage

## DDDs that do not make sense: {data-section="lvl2"}

- I check against the indo-texts
- I flag the ones that make no sense and set them to 4 weeks
